gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-gowun-dodum: Comic Relief draws its strokes with no visible shift between upstroke and sidestroke, which gives headlines a blunt, marker-like punch. And Gowun Dodum follows with a wide-mouthed lowercase a and a smooth, tube-like line, best left to the heading's big, short moments.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-hanken-grotesk: Commanding and a bit cartoonish, Comic Relief has bowls that stay open on one side and strokes of uniform thickness. But Hanken Grotesk, bent like wire with wide channels into each counter, would look lost if the heading shrank down to its size.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-host-grotesk: Comic Relief builds its letters from rods instead of carved blades, giving a bold, rounded heading that Host Grotesk meets with sweeping, open sans curves. Give the heading plenty of size.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-ibm-plex-sans-ara: Not one thick-and-thin swing slows the eye in Comic Relief, whose bowls stay open on one side and make for a blunt, commanding heading. IBM Plex Sans Arabic is its easy partner.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-ibm-plex-sans-dev: Comic Relief cuts every stem and curve from a single gauge of tubing, so the heading lands bold and commanding. IBM Plex Sans Devanagari follows with rope-loose curves that never knot at their ends; the heading likes extra size.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-ibm-plex-sans-tha: Comic Relief leaves the single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen across every letter, and the result is a bold, commanding heading. IBM Plex Sans Thai sits underneath with c shapes whose ends point apart.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-imprima: Commanding in the heading and approachable in the text, this pair trades Comic Relief's uniform strokes for Imprima's smooth, tube-like lines and flared terminals. Let the sans body stay modest in size.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-inria-sans: Inria Sans has tubular strokes like bent copper pipe and c openings you can see through, a contemporary body under a loud heading. And Comic Relief, with its uniform strokes and open bowls, gives the pair its strongest quality: a friendly punch.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-istok-web: Stems and arches of identical thickness give Comic Relief a blunt, commanding look, with bowls open on one side. Istok Web's rounded, open-sided letters make a long passage feel approachable and modern.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-jost: Loud, chunky, and cut from uniform strokes, Comic Relief sets the tone up top. And Jost carries on below with broad gaps at the terminals and a unit-width stroke, quieter but just as consistent.
